backward_compat_traps.rule: CMD17/24/25 argument is byte address for SDSC, block address for SDHC/SDXC.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Driver written for SDSC misaddresses SDHC by factor 512.

backward_compat_traps.rule: v1.x card returns no response to CMD8.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Host without timeout hangs on v1.x card.

backward_compat_traps.rule: SDHC/SDXC ignore CMD16; read block fixed at 512 B.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Drivers assume CMD16 changes read block on SDHC.

backward_compat_traps.rule: MMC uses CMD1, SD uses CMD55+ACMD41.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Wrong init sequence → illegal command response.

backward_compat_traps.rule: CS LOW during CMD0 → permanent SPI mode.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Accidental CS assertion locks card into SPI mode.

backward_compat_traps.rule: No way back from 1.8 V to 3.3 V without power cycle.
backward_compat_traps.trap: Voltage-switch failure recovery requires VDD power-cycle.

fields.spec_version: SD Physical Layer Simplified Specification Version 6.00 (April 10, 2017)

spec_lineage_sd.summary: Initial Simplified release; SDSC ≤ 2 GB; Default Speed 25 MHz.
SDHC; CMD8; Speed Class; High Speed 50 MHz.
SDXC; UHS-I (1.8 V); SDR12/25/50/104 + DDR50; Speed Class 10; UHS Speed Grade 1.
UHS-II; UHS Speed Grade 3; Power Limit; Function Extension.
Discard/FULE; COP; Application Performance Class A1/A2; Cache; Self-Maintenance; Command Queueing.

fields.version_naming_history_note: SD is managed by SD Card Association and IP holder SD-3C, LLC (Panasonic / SanDisk / Toshiba). Simplified specs are public subsets. eMMC is the sibling embedded MMC family managed by JEDEC; shares the 48-bit CMD frame structure.

key_changes.summary: SDHC / block addressing — argument to CMD17/CMD24/CMD25 is in 512-byte blocks for SDHC/SDXC, not in bytes.
UHS-I — adds 1.8 V signaling, SDR12/25/50/104 + DDR50, mandatory CMD19 tuning for SDR104, CMD11 voltage switch.
UHS-II — differential lanes on the back side of the card; out of the 9-pin standard pad assignment.
Adds CQ (Command Queueing), Cache, Self-Maintenance, A1/A2 Application Performance Class, COP (Card Ownership Protection).
